generation_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: transparent animation spritesheet for a boy bouldering upward through an academic Publications webpage.
Reference image 1 provides style: simple flat colorful cartoon climbing silhouettes with thick hand-drawn black outlines. Reference image 2 provides ONLY the original character's color palette: teal cap, navy shirt, orange trousers. CHANGE the pose and viewpoint completely from reference 2.
Primary request: EXACTLY FOUR frames of the SAME original male cartoon boulderer in a SINGLE HORIZONTAL ROW of FOUR EQUAL square cells. Overall aspect ratio 4:1, ideally 2048×512. No borders or grid lines. Full character in each cell, same character scale, each centered, every body fully within its own cell with 10% transparent margin. The four separated characters are animation frames of ONE boy, no other people.
Viewpoint: BACK / THREE-QUARTER BACK view. We see the boy's back facing a climbing wall that is invisible. Face mostly hidden, not smiling toward the camera. Young adult boy with teal baseball cap, short navy shirt, orange trousers, fitted dark climbing shoes. NO harness and NO rope.
Crucial physical pose: NATURAL BOULDERING, compact and athletic, hips close to the wall, bent knees splayed outward, elbows flexed rather than rigidly extended, body weight over toes, feet pressing against the wall with shoe toes, fingers curled as if gripping small positive rock holds. Visible engagement and tension in supporting limbs. His torso is oriented toward the invisible wall, never standing upright or floating sideways. Empty hands and feet are carefully posed for separate rocks to be placed behind them in the website.
Reading order:
Frame 1: compact balanced frog crouch, back view, both arms bent above his head, hands at different heights, both knees bent wide, both toe tips at imaginary footholds.
Frame 2: natural right-hand reach one short hold upward; left hand stays engaged above shoulder with bent elbow, left supporting foot loaded, right knee bent and seeking next foothold. Hips stay close to wall.
Frame 3: pulling upward with both elbows bent, right knee lifted high near torso and right foot braced, left foot lower pressing wall; compact body, realistic climber weight transfer.
Frame 4: balanced higher crouch with arm configuration mirrored relative to frame 1, left hand higher, knees bent, supporting shoe toes on imaginary holds.
Style: clear simple FLAT hand-drawn editorial illustration, crisp BOLD BLACK OUTLINES, solid teal/navy/orange fills, minimal details. Match reference 1 simplicity, avoid reference 2's soft shading. Character reads clearly at small size.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. Every pixel outside the four clean character silhouettes is fully transparent, not white, not black, not painted checkerboard. Crisp clean silhouette edges with normal antialiasing only, NO external glow, NO colored haze, NO drop shadows.
Absolute constraints: no rock holds anywhere, no wall, no ropes, no harness, no props, no text, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no ground. Exactly four same-boy frames in one aligned horizontal row.
extraction_prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the supplied four-frame boy-climbing spritesheet. Preserve EXACTLY the four boy poses, same scale and position, same colors, black outlines, entire composition and canvas size. Remove the entire painted gray-and-white checkerboard background. Output genuinely transparent RGBA PNG: all pixels outside the four boy silhouettes must have alpha=0. Only characters are visible. Normal antialiasing at contour edges is allowed. No external glow, no drop shadows, no haze, no white/gray/black backdrop, no replacement checkerboard. Do not add holds, wall, text, or any objects. This is alpha background extraction only; do not redraw the characters.
